backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, authorization, and publishing media blobs with admin-gated setters and persistent media arrays.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to involved frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of short summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global CSS defining color variables, light/dark themes, and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/public/PLACEHOLDER_MEDIA_README: Developer instructions for replacing placeholder media or uploading via the in-app Media Manager.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring password gate, intro popup, media sections, popups, music player, and MediaStoreProvider.
frontend/src/components/FlipImageCard.ts: Component rendering a 3D flip card that toggles between an image and a message with accessibility support and fallback image handling.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Renders several floating heart emojis with randomized animation positions and timings.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays a hero section with background image, optional media manager button, and stylized birthday-themed text.
frontend/src/components/ImageAdjustModal: Provides a modal to zoom and pan an image, allowing users to adjust transform settings and save them.
frontend/src/components/ImageMemorySecti: Shows a grid of memory images using FlipImageCard, pulling ordered images and transforms from media state.
frontend/src/components/IntroPopup.tsx: Displays an animated intro popup with a title and button to continue.
frontend/src/components/LockScreen.tsx: Renders a password lock screen that validates input and shows an error with shake animation on failure.
Shows a scrollable popup that types out a long love letter with a close button.
frontend/src/components/MediaManager.tsx: Provides a full media management interface for uploading, previewing, ordering, transforming, and publishing media assets.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Audio player with autoplay attempts, mute handling, and play/pause controls using uploaded or default song.
frontend/src/components/ProposalPopup.ts: Modal popup showing a themed proposal message with animations and close controls.
frontend/src/components/RosePetals.tsx: Renders falling rose petal emoji elements with randomized positions and animation timings.
Section displaying buttons to open the love letter and proposal popups.
frontend/src/components/VideoMemorySecti: Grid of memory videos with mute toggle, fallback handling, and support for uploaded or default sources.
frontend/src/config/imageMemory.ts: Config generates 43 image memory items with placeholder paths and rotating romantic messages.
frontend/src/config/romanticMessages.ts: List of customizable romantic messages used for image memory cards.
frontend/src/config/videoMemory.ts: Defines fallback video memory items with placeholder video file paths.
frontend/src/context/MediaStoreContext.t: Context managing uploaded media, blob URLs, ordering, transforms, syncing with backend, and cleanup.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity auth using Dfinity AuthClient, managing identity loading, login, and state flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaDraft.ts: Manages draft media state with images, videos, hero, transforms, ordering, and drag interactions for editing.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaStore.ts: Thin wrapper exposing the MediaStore context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublishWithPrechec: Handles pre-publish checks, backend media upload, local persistence, and status/error tracking for publishing changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionGate.ts: Implements a simple password‑based session unlock stored in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypingText.ts: Creates a typing animation effect by incrementally revealing text.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base plus custom romantic-themed CSS variables, animations, and 3D flip‑card styles.
frontend/src/lib/deployDiagnostics.ts: Utilities to normalize, format, and stringify errors into consistent diagnostic payloads.
frontend/src/lib/localMediaStore.ts: Implements a browser IndexedDB store for saving, retrieving, listing, and clearing media blobs by slot and type.
frontend/src/lib/publishedMediaClient.ts: Handles uploading media changes to the backend with progress callbacks and fetching published media URLs for rendering.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based parameter cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, plugins, animations, and content paths for the frontend build.
project_state.json: Describes the project state, architectural notes, known issues, and existing features for the ICP canister app.
